notes: Commencement document (Schedule TO-I, Offer to Purchase dated June 29, 2021) for EVF's tender for up to 60% (22,719,965 shares) at 99% of NAV struck at the NYSE close on the expiration date (July 30, 2021, 5:00 p.m. ET, unless extended); offer not conditioned on any minimum number of Shares. commencement_date is from the June 29, 2021 press release (seq 7) announcing 'today the commencement' of the tender offers; the same release's boilerplate says 'The Funds have not commenced the Tender Offers described in this release', and the Offer to Purchase gives August 25, 2021 as '40 business days from commencement' without dating commencement. trigger_origin activist_settlement: the offer and three conditional tenders were authorized under EVM's May 12, 2021 agreement with Saba Capital (Saba to vote for the new advisory agreement after Morgan Stanley's acquisition of Eaton Vance, tender all but one share, and refrain from proxy solicitation); merger_related is a possible alternative reading. The offer was also conditioned on shareholder approval of the New Agreement, which the filing states was met on June 24, 2021, so shareholder_approval is not listed as an open condition. 'other' condition = asset coverage requirements on senior securities. Second event: the filing discloses three Subsequent Conditional Tender Offers (Q4 of 2022, 2023 and 2024; up to 10% of then-outstanding shares at 98% of NAV) triggered if, from January to August of that year, the average discount exceeds 10% on a VWAP-and-NAV basis; window_start/window_end are null because the window is stated only as months ('from January to August of that year') for each of three years. The filing states these offers are not part of this Offer to Purchase. The June 29 release (seq 7) also covers EVG, EFT and EFR; only EVF is extracted.
